points.description: States the full form of ELISA as Enzyme Linked Immunosorbent Assay (core idea: enzyme-linked, immunosorbent, assay; minor spelling errors or wording variations accepted).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if about half is right, e.g. two of the three key words (enzyme, linked, immunosorbent/immuno-, assay) or a close but incomplete version.

rubric.notes: Full 2 marks for the expansion Enzyme Linked Immunosorbent Assay, allowing spelling slips and minor word changes. 1 mark if only part is right (for example "enzyme linked immuno..." or missing the last word). 0 for wrong or unrelated expansions.
